name: adaptec-msm
description: DESCRIPTION This is a container running the Adaptec MaxView Storage Manager application and the necessary daemons (cimserver and agent). With this container, you can manage Adaptec RAID HBA cards on the dockerhost. It is based on Centos 6 and Adaptec MSM version 2.00.21811. NOTES • It should be run privileged, in order to have access to the hardware and insert the necessary kernel modules. • Invoke arcconf CLI by executing "/bin/arcconf" in the containers console. • Tested and known to be working with Adaptec 71605, but probably works with all 7-series cards. • Template is not published by the author of this image.
